messages:
Ava (People Ops): @jamal welcome aboard! Quick 'first 72 hours' ops roadmap for new managers — tiny checklist so you can ship confidence, not paperwork. :wave:

Jamal: Thanks Ava — this looks great. Can we make sure analytics access is prioritized?

Ava (People Ops): absolutely. TL;DR checklist:
- Day 0: HR forms + payroll, set up 2FA (Okta), request laptop shipping if needed
- Day 0 evening: add preferred 1:1 cadence to calendar
- Day 1 AM: Team intro (30m), expectations sync with manager (15m)
- Day 1 PM: Technical access (git, infra dashboard, analytics), Slack + email checks
- Day 2: Product deep-dive w/ PM (45m), security quickstart (15m)
- Day 3: Shadow team calls, write draft 30/60/90 goals, ask for feedback
- By EOW: finalize 30/60/90, schedule recurring 1:1s

Priya: Where do we drop the 30/60/90 template? I want to reuse for my new hire next week.

Ava (People Ops): Template link: https://redwood.internal/ops/onboarding/30-60-90 (requires SSO). High-level manager expectations we recommend including in the template:
- Week 1: People, context, access. Confirm direct report list, org chart, intro notes.
- Week 4 (30): deliver a scoped, visible improvement (bugfix, doc, small feature).
- Week 8 (60): lead cross-team effort, own a metric trend.
- Week 12 (90): deliver measurable project and clear next quarter plan.

Taylor (IT): @jamal I can pre-provision read access to analytics. Please DM your corp email. For SSH key (if you need to push):
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "jamal@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Paste the pub key into the onboarding portal under "Tech Access" and I’ll attach the right groups. :computer:

Jamal: Sent the email & key. Also thinking weekly skip-level sync + biweekly team retro. Adding to calendar now.

Ava (People Ops): Love that cadence. I added a "first 30/60/90 review" meeting template to the calendar invite drafts. If anything blocks access ping #help or DM me directly. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: Reminder set: Complete HR paperwork (due in 48h).
